posts.title: SSC CGL 2026 Online Form
posts.desc: Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026. Total 17,727 posts of various ministries and departments.

faqs.q: What is the SSC CGL 2026 application fee?
faqs.a: The application fee is ₹100 for General/OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from the fee.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.a: The age limit is 18-32 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for reserved categories.

posts.title: UPSC IAS Pre 2026 Notification
posts.desc: Union Public Service Commission Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination 2027. Gateway to IAS, IPS, IFS and other central services.
details: Posts: IAS, IPS, IFS & 24 other services
Attempts: 6 for General, more for reserved

faqs.q: How many attempts are allowed in UPSC CSE?
faqs.a: General category candidates get 6 attempts. OBC gets 9 and SC/ST candidates have no attempt limit.

faqs.q: What is the UPSC application fee?
faqs.a: The fee is ₹100 for General/OBC candidates. Female, SC, ST and PwD candidates are exempted.

posts.title: RRB NTPC 2026 Apply Online
posts.desc: Railway Recruitment Board Non-Technical Popular Categories 2026. Recruitment for Graduate and Undergraduate posts in Indian Railways.
details: Posts: Clerk, Station Master, TC, Goods Guard

faqs.q: What posts are covered in RRB NTPC?
faqs.a: NTPC covers Non-Technical Popular Categories like Clerk, Station Master, Train Controller, Goods Guard and Ticket Collector.

faqs.q: What is the RRB NTPC exam pattern?
faqs.a: The selection has two Computer Based Tests (CBT). CBT-1 is qualifying, CBT-2 determines the merit list.

posts.title: IBPS PO 2026 Notification
posts.desc: IBPS Probationary Officer 2026 recruitment for 41 public sector banks. CRP PO/MT-XVI.

faqs.q: What is IBPS PO eligibility?
faqs.a: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university and must be between 20-30 years of age.

faqs.q: How many attempts are allowed for IBPS PO?
faqs.a: General candidates get 4 attempts, OBC 7, and SC/ST/PwD candidates have no attempt limit.

posts.title: Delhi Police Constable 2026
posts.desc: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Recruitment 2026. Direct recruitment of constables in Delhi Police.
details: Physical: Race, Long Jump, High Jump

faqs.q: What is the minimum qualification for Delhi Police Constable?
faqs.a: Candidates must be 10th pass from a recognized board. Age should be between 18-25 years.

faqs.q: Is there a physical test?
faqs.a: Yes. Male candidates run 1600m in 6.5 minutes; females run 800m in 4.5 minutes, followed by long jump and high jump.

posts.title: Agniveer Army 2026 Apply
posts.desc: Indian Army Agniveer Recruitment Rally 2026 for Agniveer General Duty, Technical, Clerk and Tradesman posts.

faqs.q: What is the Agniveer age limit?
faqs.a: Candidates must be between 17.5 and 21 years of age on the date of enrolment.

faqs.q: What is the Agniveer salary?
faqs.a: Agniveers receive ₹30,000 per month in the first year, increasing annually, plus risk and hardship allowances.

posts.title: CTET 2026 Registration
posts.desc: Central Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 conducted by CBSE. Certificate valid for all central government schools (KVS, NVS, etc.).

faqs.q: Is CTET certificate valid for life?
faqs.a: As per current rules the CTET certificate is valid for 7 years from the date of result declaration.

faqs.q: Can I apply for both CTET papers?
faqs.a: Yes, candidates can apply for both Paper-I and Paper-II if they meet the eligibility for both.

posts.title: UPSSSC PET 2026 Result
posts.desc: UPSSSC Preliminary Eligibility Test 2026 result has been declared. Check your result and cutoff for UP government jobs.

faqs.q: How to check UPSSSC PET 2026 result?
faqs.a: Visit the official UPSSSC website, enter your roll number and date of birth to download your result.

faqs.q: What is the PET cutoff?
faqs.a: Cutoffs are released category-wise after the result. General category cutoff is usually higher than reserved categories.

posts.title: SSC GD 2026 Result Declared
posts.desc: SSC GD Constable 2026 final result has been declared. Check your status and next steps for document verification.

faqs.q: How to check SSC GD result?
faqs.a: Visit ssc.gov.in, click on the SSC GD result link, enter your registration number and roll number.

faqs.q: What happens after SSC GD result?
faqs.a: Qualified candidates are called for document verification and medical examination.

posts.title: RRB Group D 2026 Result
posts.desc: RRB Group D Level-1 2026 result declared for 32,438 posts across Indian Railways zones.

faqs.q: What is the RRB Group D physical test?
faqs.a: Male candidates lift 35kg and run 1000m in 4 min 15 sec. Female candidates lift 20kg and run 1000m in 5 min 40 sec.

faqs.q: When is the PET scheduled?
faqs.a: PET dates are announced zone-wise after the CBT result. Check your zone website for the schedule.

posts.title: NEET UG 2027 Admit Card
posts.desc: NEET UG 2027 admit card will be released on the NTA website. Download hall ticket for the medical entrance exam.

faqs.q: When will NEET 2027 admit card release?
faqs.a: The admit card is typically released 2-4 weeks before the exam date on the official NTA website.

faqs.q: What documents do I need with the admit card?
faqs.a: Carry a printed admit card along with a valid photo ID proof like Aadhaar, Passport or Driving License.

posts.title: SSC CGL Tier-I Admit Card 2026
posts.desc: SSC CGL Tier-I 2026 admit card released region-wise. Download your hall ticket from the SSC regional website.

faqs.q: How to download SSC CGL admit card?
faqs.a: Visit your SSC regional website, click on the admit card link, and enter your registration number and password.

faqs.q: What if my SSC CGL admit card is not available?
faqs.a: Admit cards are released region-wise. Wait for your region's release or contact the regional SSC office.

posts.title: UPSC CSE Prelims 2026 Answer Key
posts.desc: UPSC Civil Services Prelims 2026 official answer key released. Challenge window open for objections.

faqs.q: How to challenge the UPSC answer key?
faqs.a: Log in to the UPSC website, select the questions you want to challenge, pay the fee, and submit your objections with proof.

faqs.q: Is the UPSC answer key fee refundable?
faqs.a: Yes, the ₹100 fee per question is refunded if the challenge is accepted and the answer is changed.

posts.title: RRB ALP 2026 Answer Key
posts.desc: RRB ALP (Assistant Loco Pilot) 2026 CBT-1 answer key released with response sheet. Raise objections before the deadline.

faqs.q: How to check RRB ALP answer key?
faqs.a: Download the answer key and your response sheet from the RRB website and compare your answers to calculate the score.

faqs.q: What is the objection fee?
faqs.a: Candidates can raise objections against any question by paying ₹50 per question. It is refunded if the objection is valid.

posts.title: SSC CGL Syllabus & Exam Pattern
posts.desc: Complete SSC CGL 2026 syllabus and exam pattern for Tier-I, Tier-II, Tier-III and Tier-IV with marking scheme.

faqs.q: How many sections in SSC CGL Tier-I?
faqs.a: Tier-I has 4 sections: General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Comprehension.

faqs.q: Is there negative marking in SSC CGL?
faqs.a: Yes, 0.50 marks are deducted for each wrong answer in both Tier-I and Tier-II.

posts.title: UPSC IAS Syllabus 2026
posts.desc: Complete UPSC Civil Services syllabus: Prelims GS Paper 1 & 2, Mains 9 papers, and interview. Optional subject list.

faqs.q: How many papers in UPSC Mains?
faqs.a: There are 9 papers in Mains. Two are qualifying (English and Indian Language), the remaining 7 count toward merit.

faqs.q: What is the UPSC total marks?
faqs.a: Mains is 1750 marks and the interview is 275 marks, making a total of 2025 marks.

posts.title: CUET UG 2027 Registration
posts.desc: Common University Entrance Test (CUET UG) 2027 for admission to 250+ central and state universities. Apply online.

faqs.q: Which universities accept CUET UG?
faqs.a: All central universities including DU, BHU, JNU, AMU and many state and private universities accept CUET UG scores.

faqs.q: How many subjects can I choose in CUET?
faqs.a: Candidates can choose up to 6 subjects: 2 languages, 3 domain subjects, and 1 general test.

posts.title: JEE Main 2027 Apply Online
posts.desc: JEE Main 2027 Session-1 application form released by NTA for B.E./B.Tech and B.Arch admissions.

faqs.q: Who can apply for JEE Main 2027?
faqs.a: Candidates who passed 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in 2025, 2026 or appearing in 2027 can apply.

faqs.q: Is JEE Main required for NITs and IIITs?
faqs.a: Yes, admission to NITs, IIITs and GFTIs is based on JEE Main rank, and top rankers qualify for JEE Advanced.
